legend.0: Flee: ghosts are close and closing; give up pellets to survive.
legend.1: Cautious: keep distance, take only safe pellets.
legend.2: Neutral: normal pellet collection, no immediate threat.
legend.3: Hunting: powered up or ghosts are distant; push into dense pellets.
legend.4: Reckless: powered up with ghosts nearby; actively chase them down.
